overall_assessment: Heading-based splitting works well for UiA: learning outcomes are complete, 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen' correctly goes to coursework_requirements, and the boilerplate flags are false alarms (short but genuine prerequisites/assessment, identical text across sibling practice courses). The real defects are the unmapped 'Faget i praksis' sub-section being glued onto course_content or teaching_methods, and four plans with no body content at all (upstream capture problem).

findings.evidence: I løpet av de 5 dagene i praksis skal det legges til rette for at studenten får erfaring med bruk av ulike undervisningsressurser i matematikk og elevaktive undervisningsmetoder.
findings.description: The 'Faget i praksis' sub-section (placement description) has no canonical heading mapping. In the MA courses it is appended to course_content (the pre-pass 'leak->teaching_methods' flag is real, although the leak is of a heading that is not in the heading map); in NO-156 it ends up at the start of teaching_methods. Placement logistics therefore pollute course_content, and in NO-156 the 'Faget i praksis' text is merged with Undervisnings- og læringsformer. In MA-457 and MA-442 (2025) the heading is also run together with its text ('Faget i praksisI løpet', 'Faget i praksis Studenten').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has no pattern for 'Faget i praksis', so the splitter does not cut there and the text is glued to the preceding section (course_content) or, when the heading is separated by blank lines, to the following one (teaching_methods).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern '^Faget i praksis' in R/section_heading_map.R mapped to teaching_methods (or a discarded block), placed so it terminates course_content; also split on the heading when it is not followed by a newline (e.g. 'Faget i praksisI løpet').

findings.description: Four of the 20 courses (PED428, IDR418, NAT115, SV-158, all 2023 autumn) have no sections at all. The plan text contains only the header, study programme list and (for two) the credit-reduction table; Læringsutbytte, Innhold, Eksamen etc. are absent, so there is nothing to split. The content was lost before section extraction.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Upstream harvest/fulltext capture returned only the page shell for these 2023-autumn pages (content not rendered or selector missed it); not a defect in R/extract_sections.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-fetch these plans and inspect the HTML; adjust selector in R/institution_config.R for uia if a different layout is used. Flag courses whose plan lacks 'Læringsutbytte' as no-content in the section dataset rather than silently emitting zero rows.

findings.evidence: Det er krav om minimum 70 % obligatorisk deltagelse i undervisningen.
findings.description: Mandatory-attendance requirement sits inside teaching_methods (together with workload hours and practice-day counts). It is a pass/approve gate and by the codebook belongs in coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Splitting is purely heading-based; sentences in 'Undervisnings- og læringsformer' are not classified.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional sentence-level post-step for uia moving sentences matching 'krav om .*(deltagelse|frammøte|tilstedeværelse)' to coursework_requirements; otherwise document as a known limitation.

findings.description: Sub-headings Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse are dropped while the repeated lead-in line ('Den nyutdannede læreren', 'Studenten skal') is kept, so the three groups are separated only by blank lines and the group labels are lost. Content itself is complete.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-headings of learning_outcomes are stripped by the splitter/.clean_sections() without being re-emitted.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep recognised sub-headings (Kunnskap, Ferdigheter, Generell kompetanse and nynorsk variants) as text lines inside learning_outcomes instead of removing them.
